rationale: The assistant reached the correct diagnosis (snapped drive belt) via the ideal first step (unplug, turn drum by hand), sensibly checked the jockey pulley, and recommended a belt without inventing a part number. It stumbled badly on the tensioner: the message 'This is the tensioner (jockey pulley)' contained no description (apparently a missing image), forcing the customer to ask twice and the description to be repeated three times. It also never followed up on obtaining the full model/serial for ordering the correct belt, and the fitting instructions were generic, though safe isolation was emphasised throughout.
